description:
space.rs handle_space_join: two concurrent joins for DIFFERENT accounts silently lose one membership.

The sequence:
1. Request A (bob) reads current_members = [alice]
2. Request B (charlie) reads current_members = [alice]
3. Request A appends bob, writes [alice, bob]
4. Request B appends charlie, writes [alice, charlie] — bob's entry is lost

Root cause: the members list is a Value array that must be rewritten atomically. The current read-append-write is a classic TOCTOU race, but this is a write-clobber race (two writes for different data) rather than a check-then-act race.

Distinct from JMAP-4ii.49 (same-account duplicate insert race) — this affects different accounts joining simultaneously and silently drops one member.

Fix requires atomic append at the backend level (e.g., a dedicated add_member operation) or optimistic locking (check-version/etag on the space object).
title: Space/join: concurrent joins overwrite each other's membership
